Bug_Title: "@SpringBootApplication" and "@ComponentScan" should not be used in the default package
Bug_Explanation: The Spring Boot application annotation is used in the default package, which causes the entire classpath to be scanned. This can lead to slow start-up times and a BeanDefinitionStoreException.
